timeline.event: checkout config_v42 deployed with EU tax endpoint mapping change
tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: deployed configuration change caused incorrect EU tax endpoint mapping
why_it_happened: A configuration change was deployed that switched EU tax endpoint mapping
The incorrect configuration routed EU orders to a US-east endpoint that cannot handle EU tax calculations
Region mismatch caused tax calculation failures, leading to EU checkout request failures
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (gateway was healthy at 09:20)
Database pool exhaustion (errors were region mismatch, not pool timeout saturation)
immediate_mitigation: rollback checkout config to the last known good version (config_v41)
